steps.title: The axes
steps.say: Price goes up the vertical axis and quantity along the horizontal axis.

steps.title: Demand curve
steps.say: Demand slopes down: the lower the price, the more people want to buy.

steps.title: Supply curve
steps.say: Supply slopes up: the higher the price, the more sellers want to sell.

steps.title: Starting equilibrium
steps.say: Where the curves cross, the market settles at price 5 and quantity 5.

steps.title: Demand rises
steps.say: Now buyers want more at every price, so the demand curve shifts to the right.

steps.title: Price goes up
steps.say: Buyers compete for the same supply, so the price rises, and sellers respond by selling more. Both price and quantity go up.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.say: Drag the curves to see how the price and quantity respond to different shifts.
